candidates.explanation: When updateUserDto.photo is undefined (field omitted, e.g. editing only firstName), the code sets photo = null. The mapper turns null into a null photo, so the repository update clears the photo relation and the avatar disappears. Omitted should mean leave unchanged (undefined). Only an explicit null should clear the photo.

fix.description: Change the branch to `else if (updateUserDto.photo === null) { photo = null; }`. This leaves photo undefined when it is omitted, so it isn't touched, and it clears the photo only when null is sent explicitly.
